children: The New York Fed’s Services Business Activity Index dropped to -8.7 in September 2026 from 0.5 in August, reversing the upbeat sentiment recorded over the previous two months.

The business climate index fell ten points to -35.9, as nearly half of respondents reported an unfavorable climate, indicating that business conditions were notably worse than normal as supply availability continued to deteriorate.
Employment edged lower by seven points to -4.9, while wage growth remained close to levels seen in recent months.
Input price growth continued to increase significantly, while selling-price pressures also picked up.
Looking ahead, firms expect modest growth in business activity over the next six months, with employment expected to increase.
Price pressures are also expected to remain elevated as supply availability continues to deteriorate.

title: NY Services Activity Slumps
